response.original_title: See You at the Next Cattle Drive
response.overview: During the traditional *Bois de Máscaras* (Masked Oxen) festival in São Caetano de Odivelas, Pará, Luiz—a sound system crew member from Belém—meets Bruna, the coordinator of a *Boi* group. Amidst the booming sound systems, dances, and colors filling the streets, a romance blossoms that blends reality with enchantment, revealing the living magic of a city pulsating with culture and tradition.
response.title: See You at the Next Cattle Drive
